business_problem: SK Shieldus needed a more scalable analytics foundation because its legacy environment could not support advanced machine learning for proactive security services, dispatch optimization, and customer retention.
solution_summary: SK Shieldus uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakeflow to support predictive security operations and churn prevention. SK Shieldus needed a more scalable analytics foundation because its legacy environment could not support advanced machine learning for proactive security services, dispatch optimization, and customer retention. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Lakeflow, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Transaction, claims, risk, and event data are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Lakeflow; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic.
